gate: EXPERIENCE_START_P_V2 - Large-N holdout / cost policy: do FAMILY_MIN / FAMILY_MAX start-p policies from verified experience keep correctness, cut retries and cut the total service cost at larger N?
classification: FCC_N SCENARIO FAMILY - NOT THE 2/3-ATOM CERTIFICATION SCOPE

baseline.this_branch: claude/experience-start-p-v2 in the main checkout (no worktree); clean, 0 untracked at start

terms.lowest_observed_success_p: the lowest p among the verified passes actually run that ended DECIDED
terms.highest_observed_failure_p: the highest p among the verified passes actually run that did not end DECIDED
terms.forbidden: true_minimum / minimum_required are never written: no p was searched exhaustively

already_established_not_retested: V1: EXACT_MEMORY 18/18 first-pass on identical requests (~55 % wall/CPU cut), FAMILY_MIN 4/5 and FAMILY_MAX 5/5 first-pass on unseen N, zero correctness difference, P2 fallback worked. EXACT replay is not run again.

sources: SELECTOR_SERVICE_V1@0e6953b:docs/active/selector_service_v1/laptop_run - every executed pass (service + shadow), checker EVIDENCE OK
EXPERIENCE_START_P_V1@abf5ac7:docs/active/experience_start_p_v1/laptop_run - every service pass (the candidate experience), checker EVIDENCE OK (re-run on the desktop, identical)
training_bundle_v2.not_included: V1 serial reference passes (re-measurements, not candidate experience), every p=128 timing record of other experiments, and anything produced by this V2 campaign
training_bundle_v2.records: one ExperienceRecord per executed pass, rebuilt from the source runner records (not copied from the candidate file); VERIFIED only when the source checker verdict is EVIDENCE OK with 0 bit mismatches
training_bundle_v2.dedup: key = (source_evidence_id, run_id); a second record with the same key or the same record content hash is dropped and counted; the bundle stores record_sha256 for every record
training_bundle_v2.contracts: the physics / numeric contract hashes of each source are computed from its execution_seal source table; every source must equal the current contracts, every record must carry them and evaluator rw:R1+R2, else the build fails
training_bundle_v2.summary: per exact key lowest_observed_success_p / highest_observed_failure_p; per family (FCC_N, T, evaluator, contracts) FAMILY_MIN / FAMILY_MAX = min / max over exact keys of lowest_observed_success_p; VERIFIED records only
training_bundle_v2.seal: the bundle file and its sha256 are committed before any policy / service / campaign code; the campaign verifies the hash at load and refuses to run otherwise; read-only during the campaign

policies.FAMILY_MIN: start p = FAMILY_MIN of the request's family key in the sealed V2 bundle (else 64)
policies.FAMILY_MAX: start p = FAMILY_MAX of the request's family key in the sealed V2 bundle (else 64)
policies.after_first_pass: identical for all policies: the unchanged P2 (precision_pilot_a1.policies.next_p('P2', ...), p2_next, cap 1024) chooses every later p; DECIDED / STOP is final; REFUSED_AT_CAP when P2 returns CAP
policies.no_correctness_role: a policy only picks the first p
policies.exact_memory: not compared; for every evaluation request the exact-memory lookup is recorded before the runs and must be a MISS (checker)

evaluation_requests.order: per repetition the requests in the listed order; within a request the three policies rotated by repetition index
evaluation_requests.holdout_check: none of the four (N, T) is an exact key of the V2 bundle; a search of every docs/active/**/records.json.gz found (12, 1000) only as p = 128 timing records of E2_PAIR_PARALLEL_V1 / MULTIATOM_PARALLEL_V1 (allowed; never read by any V2 code and their outcomes were not looked at); (40, 100), (64, 100), (16, 1000) appear nowhere

execution_plan.service_passes: fixed W6: evaluator rw:R1+R2, backend CPU_PARALLEL, worker_count 6, main_cpu 0, worker_cpus [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0] (selector_service_v1.selector.fixed_plan('W6', p); the validated W6 placement); Selector V1 is not called and not changed
execution_plan.campaign_process: pinned to CPU 0 as in SELECTOR_SERVICE_V1 / V1

platform.machine: Vast.ai instance 52763629 (rented by the designer for this stage): AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16 cores / 32 threads, 32 CPUs visible, Linux container (vastbridge / proot); first run of this executor family on Linux and on this CPU
platform.placement_check: at setup the campaign reads /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu{0..5}/topology; CPUs 0-5 must be six different physical cores (no SMT siblings among them) and all in the affinity mask, else it stops before any pass
platform.cpu_clock_on_linux: the unchanged executor measures CPU with Windows QueryProcessCycleTime, which does not exist on Linux. A measurement shim experiments/experience_start_p_v2/linux_shim/sitecustomize.py, active only when ESP2_LINUX_CLOCK=1 and on Linux, replaces exactly two measurement functions of experiments/multiatom_parallel_v1/run (cycles -> CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID nanoseconds of the whole process, _mem -> peak RSS MB) in every process including spawned workers; cycle rate is then exactly 1e9. No physics, numeric, scheduling or result code is touched; the executor files keep their hashes (sealed). On Windows (test fixture) the shim is inactive.
platform.mpmath: mpmath 1.3.0 with the pure-python backend (no gmpy2), psutil 7.2.2, in a separate venv; backend recorded and must be 'python'
platform.cross_platform_anchor: before the evaluation: one CPU_SERIAL pass N = 8, T = 100, p = 107 (a training request, not an evaluation request) must be bit-identical (outcome, completed_steps, stop, stop_step, cells, endpoints_key, initial digest) to the laptop SELECTOR_SERVICE_V1 serial pass at the same (N, T, p); a mismatch stops the campaign
platform.transport: code goes to the node as a git bundle of this branch (no push); evidence comes back by scp; no node-side git commit
platform.node_power: the job stops the instance itself at the end (after a grace period for fetching the evidence) unless a process not belonging to this job is using >= 25 % CPU, in which case it is left running and reported
platform.desktop: not measured (external load); laptop not used for this stage
platform.scheduling: processes on the node run at nice 10 (the container default, observed before the seal); placement CPUs 0-5 are cores 0-5 (SMT siblings 16-21 unused by this job); recorded in the setup

cost_estimate.basis: laptop V1 / SELECTOR_SERVICE_V1 DECIDED W6 passes: ~1.25e-3 CPU s per pair-step (N = 20, 32 at T = 100; N = 7, 10 at T = 1000), serial ~0.89e-3; no full request probe; Vast per-core speed unknown before the run
cost_estimate.expected: ~5 passes per request per repetition (BASE64 2, MIN 1-2, MAX 1-2): 582 x 5 x 3 = ~8,700 CPU s service + ~1,900 CPU s serial references (~4.5 distinct p per request) = ~10,600 CPU s; wall ~ 60 min at laptop speed
cost_estimate.worst_plausible: 8 passes per request per repetition and 7 distinct p per request: ~16,900 CPU s
cost_estimate.cap: 20,000 CPU s (process CPU, cycle-counted / CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID), ~1.9 x expected and above the worst plausible chain; the campaign stops at the next pass boundary when exceeded
cost_estimate.smoke: allowed: a cost-only N = 64, T = 3 pass at p = 64 (W6 and serial) on the node to check the shim and the per-pass overhead; its outcome is not used by any policy and is not an evaluation request

load_rule: unchanged rule from E2_PAIR_PARALLEL_V1 (other processes >= 100 % of one logical CPU, or a python / roblox / codex / node process >= 25 % -> CONTAMINATED; kept, checked, excluded from performance numbers); additionally recorded for information only: /proc/loadavg and the /proc/stat steal counter at each snapshot
correctness_hard_gate: every pass bit-identical (outcome, completed_steps, stop, stop_step, cells, endpoints_key, initial-state digest) to one CPU_SERIAL reference pass at the same (N, T, p) run after the evaluation; final cells re-derived by the checker from the stored endpoints; any difference fails the stage
p2_fallback_record: every pass stores its index, p, plan and runner record; the checker re-derives each later p with its own P2 implementation from the stored earlier passes
leakage: the V2 bundle is read-only; evaluation results go only to candidate_v2/ (records UNVERIFIED, samples UNVERIFIED_UNTIL_CHECKER); no decision of this campaign reads them
experience_sample_v2: one per service run: pre_run_features {N, T, pair_count, evaluator, topology_class, physics_contract_hash, numeric_contract_hash, initial_state_digest}; policy; starting_p; attempts [{p, outcome, completed_steps, backend, workers, cpu_s, wall_s}]; observed_summary {highest_observed_failure_p, lowest_observed_success_p, total_service_wall_s, total_service_cpu_s}; no true-minimum label

metrics.per_service_run: service wall, total CPU, passes, failed passes, first-pass success, first / failed / final pass wall and CPU, retry_cpu_fraction, retry_wall_fraction, starting_p, final_success_p
metrics.per_policy: first_try_success_requests (all clean repetitions first-pass DECIDED), first_try_success_runs, retry_count (failed passes summed over clean runs), retry_cpu_fraction and retry_wall_fraction (failed-pass cost / total, over clean runs)
metrics.totals: SUM over the 4 requests of the per-request median service wall and median CPU
metrics.equal_weight: for each request the ratio policy median / reference median (wall and CPU separately), averaged over the 4 requests (arithmetic mean)

decision_rules_sealed.precondition: the correctness hard gate passes and the checker verdict is EVIDENCE OK; otherwise no performance verdict is issued
decision_rules_sealed.USEFUL_COST_POLICY_CANDIDATE: for FAMILY_MIN and for FAMILY_MAX separately: total wall <= 0.80 x BASE64 total wall AND total CPU <= 0.80 x BASE64 total CPU; otherwise INFO_ONLY

min_vs_max.definitions: Sw = MAX total wall / MIN total wall, Sc = the same for CPU; Ew = mean over requests of (MAX median wall / MIN median wall), Ec = the same for CPU
min_vs_max.MAX_WIN: Sw <= 0.95 and Sc <= 0.95 and Ew <= 1.02 and Ec <= 1.02
min_vs_max.MIN_WIN: 1/Sw <= 0.95 and 1/Sc <= 0.95 and mean(MIN/MAX wall) <= 1.02 and mean(MIN/MAX CPU) <= 1.02
min_vs_max.DISTRIBUTION_SENSITIVE: not MAX_WIN / MIN_WIN, and for wall or for CPU one policy wins the total by >= 5 % (S <= 0.95 or 1/S <= 0.95) while the equal-weight mean of the same metric points the other way by more than 2 % (for a MAX total win: E > 1.02; for a MIN total win: mean(MIN/MAX) > 1.02)
min_vs_max.TIE: none of the above and |S - 1| < 0.05 and |E - 1| < 0.05 for both wall and CPU
min_vs_max.MIXED: anything else (reported with all four numbers)

decision_rules_sealed.first_try_counts: recorded and reported, not used alone for any verdict

stop_candidates.A_keep_simple_policy: FAMILY_MIN or FAMILY_MAX passes the hard gate, is first-pass successful in every clean run of at least 3 of 4 requests, and is a USEFUL_COST_POLICY_CANDIDATE -> report: keep the simple experience table, no regression / neural model, next GPU pair pilot
stop_candidates.B_table_range_limit: both MIN and MAX first-pass fail in 2 or more requests, or neither is a USEFUL_COST_POLICY_CANDIDATE -> report the range limit of the family table; decide on data needs before any model
stop_candidates.otherwise: report as is; the designer decides

counterexamples_sought: A: FAMILY_MAX first-pass failure at large N (range limit of the table)
B: FAMILY_MAX succeeds but the higher p raises the pass cost substantially
C: FAMILY_MIN always succeeds, so the MAX insurance is unnecessary
D: T = 100 and T = 1000 behave differently
E: at the same p the cost profile changes with N

amendment_1_before_any_evaluation_run: Before the code seal: (1) desktop tests (18 PASS) used the scratch request N = 6, T = 100 and the anchor; (2) on the Vast node, the same tests passed under Linux with the shim (REMOTE LINUX related set, 18 PASS), and a dry campaign on N = 6, T = 100 (not an evaluation request) gave BASE64 64 -> 107, FAMILY_MIN 106 and FAMILY_MAX 109 first-pass DECIDED (the same as V1 amendment 1), every pass bit-identical to its serial reference, the cross-platform anchor N = 8, T = 100, p = 107 IDENTICAL to the laptop serial pass; (3) the cost-only smoke N = 64, T = 3, p = 64 took W6 e2e 1.21 s / CPU 5.04 s and serial e2e 4.36 s / CPU 4.32 s (outcome not looked at). Defect found by the dry run and fixed before the seal: the placement check read the CPU mask of the campaign process after it had pinned itself to CPU 0; it now reads the container cpuset (0-31). Transport note: GNU tar under the node's proot cannot create directories; the evaluation code is taken by git clone of a bundle (no overlay).
